results.title: Bun Guide: Install, Configure & Deploy the Fast JS Runtime | DeployHQ
results.content: Bun: The Complete Guide to the All-in-One JavaScript Runtime Bun is an all-in-one JavaScript runtime built from the ground up to be fast. Written in Zig and using JavaScriptCore (the engine powering Safari) instead of V8, Bun combines a runtime, package manager, bundler, and test runner into a single executable.
